diagnoses.description:
Environment/permissions constraint: the syzkaller checkout under /opt is root-owned, preventing creation of ./bin and thus preventing the exact requested build invocation in-place.
Evidence: The required verification commands were run in “/home/agent/syzkaller-build” rather than “/opt/syzkaller” because /opt/syzkaller was not writable for build outputs (noted in the final summary in Turn 38: “Running these directly under /opt/syzkaller fails here because /opt/syzkaller is root-owned and not writable for creating ./bin outputs.”).
Trajectory location: turn 31 (and overall verification step)

Incorrect assumption about the generated output directory name/location (the actual directory is sys/gen, as found in Turn 35).
Evidence: The agent attempted “grep -R ... sys/linux/gen” and got “grep: sys/linux/gen: No such file or directory”.
Trajectory location: turn 34

Mismatch between expectations and the actual content/format of sys/gen artifacts (compressed gob blobs not directly greppable for source identifiers), so this check was not informative for confirming symbol inclusion.
Evidence: Ran “grep -R 'ppdev|parport|PPSETMODE|fd_ppdev' -n sys/gen | head ...” but the observation shows no matching output lines.
Trajectory location: turn 36
